projects.title: The Morel Residence
projects.excerpt: A sweeping full-home transformation turning a dated colonial apartment into a curated retreat of brass, velvet, and botanical warmth.
projects.brief: The Morels had lived in this 1970s colonial building for two decades. Every room told a different story — none of them theirs. Our brief was to create a cohesive narrative through the entire home that honoured the building's bones while introducing a layered, editorial warmth. We stripped everything back to structure, rebuilt with intention, and furnished with restraint.
projects.challenge: The building's load-bearing walls couldn't be moved, creating an awkward traffic flow between the living and dining areas. We resolved this by designing a bespoke brass-and-cane screen that defines spaces without closing them off.
projects.clientQuote: Arjun didn't just redesign our home — he gave us a place that finally feels like us. Every corner has something to discover.

projects.title: The Fernandez Kitchen
projects.excerpt: Sage green cabinetry, terracotta tile, and honest brass hardware — a kitchen that earns its place at the heart of the home.
projects.brief: A compact but ambitious kitchen renovation guided by one word: warmth. The Fernandez family cooks every day together. The kitchen needed to hold that.
projects.challenge: Low ceiling heights and a single small window demanded careful lighting strategy — layered task, ambient and accent lighting entirely replace natural light after 4pm.
projects.clientQuote: We didn't know a kitchen could be this beautiful. We eat at home every night now.

projects.title: Belvedere Master Suite
projects.excerpt: Deep terracotta drapes, carved wood, and a bed that invites you to stay — a master suite that restores rather than just rests.
projects.brief: A master suite designed around the idea of ritual. Morning light through linen curtains. Evening warmth from brass sconces. Every texture chosen to be touched.
projects.challenge: The existing layout placed the walk-in wardrobe as a visual dead-end. We reconfigured it behind a full-height upholstered panel, creating a seamless wall of calm.
projects.clientQuote: I finally have a bedroom I don't want to leave in the morning. That's everything.

projects.title: The Patel Dining Room
projects.excerpt: A gallery wall, a round walnut table, and the art of gathering — where every dinner becomes an occasion.
projects.brief: The Patels entertain constantly. Their old dining room was functional but forgettable. Now it's the reason people accept every invitation.
projects.challenge: An asymmetric room shape made standard furniture arrangements feel clumsy. A round table and radially arranged art wall resolved the geometry beautifully.
projects.clientQuote: Our dining room is now everyone's favourite room in the house. Including ours.

projects.title: The Writer's Study
projects.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, olive walls, and a cognac leather chair — a study that makes you want to write one more page.
projects.brief: Our client, a novelist, wanted a room that felt like his books looked — layered, rich, slightly worn at the edges, and absolutely conducive to long hours of thought.
projects.challenge: The room had zero natural light. We designed the entire lighting scheme to simulate it: warm-toned LED strips hidden behind bookshelf moldings create a consistent amber glow.
projects.clientQuote: I finished my novel in this room. I don't think that's a coincidence.

reviews.name: Priya Morel
reviews.text: Arjun transformed our home from a collection of rooms into a coherent, beautiful story. He listened deeply, challenged us in the best way, and delivered something far beyond what we imagined. Every guest who visits asks who designed it. The pride we feel is immeasurable.

reviews.name: Sofia Fernandez
reviews.text: Our kitchen was a nightmare — dark, small, and unloved. Arjun saw something in it we couldn't. Now it's the heart of our home. The sage green cabinets, the terracotta tiles, the brass taps — it's a space that makes cooking feel like a pleasure, not a chore.

reviews.name: Asha Mehta
reviews.text: I've worked with interior designers before but Arjun is in a different category. He understood my vision and elevated it. The bedroom he designed is so restorative — the colours, the textures, the light. I sleep better than I ever have. Worth every rupee.

reviews.name: Vikram Patel
reviews.text: Arjun has this rare quality: he makes you trust the process completely. We were nervous about a round table and the gallery wall — he knew. Six months later, it's the room we're most proud of. Our dinner parties have gotten noticeably better.

reviews.name: Rahul Bose
reviews.text: As a writer, my environment is everything. I told Arjun I wanted a room that felt like a place where important things happen. He delivered exactly that. The olive walls, the shelves, the quality of the light — it's perfect. I finished my novel in this room.

reviews.name: Nandita Shah
reviews.text: Great experience working with Arjun. He is professional, creative, and keeps you informed throughout. Our living room looks stunning and has received so many compliments. Minor timeline delays but the result absolutely makes up for it.
